	change_variable = { which = pe_val_d_pe_firm_fffe value = pe_tmp }
	set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_cnt_f }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = -0.05 }
	change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 1 }

	multiply_variable = { which = pe_val_d_pe_firm_fffe value = pe_tmp }
	}

# Colony scope: planet-specific values in root variables. pe_dval_u = value of one state
# city district on this planet (from its zones). pe_ent_val = value of one
# entertainer job here (amenity shortage), pe_spec_<letter> = 1.6 for shares that match the
# planet's designation, 0.8 for the other shares on such a specialised planet, else 1.

	root = {

		# Firm values here (see pe_deposit_fetch, pe_consider_variant): pe_pf_u / pe_pf_r =
		# workforce of a city / rural firm at stage "normal" per 200 (planet 1 / 1.5,
		# habitat 1, void dwellers' habitat 1.5). The state's districts: pe_spf_r = base

		# the specialisation's jobs of its district type here.

			limit = { exists = owner owner = { is_void_dweller_empire = yes } }

# Deposit scope: the firm's size here. pe_sz = relative to stage "normal" (value, costs),
# pe_szd = what the next stage adds to it, pe_wfall = its workforce.
pe_deposit_fetch_scale = {
	set_variable = { which = pe_sz value = pe_stage } if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { planet = { NOT = { uses_district_set = habitat } } check_variable = { which = pe_code value > 62 } } planet = { uses_district_set = habitat exists = owner owner = { is_void_dweller_empire = yes } } } } change_variable = { which = pe_sz value = 2 } divide_variable = { which = pe_sz value = 3 } } else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 0 } } set_variable = { which = pe_sz value = 0.65 } } else = { change_variable = { which = pe_sz value = 1 } multiply_variable = { which = pe_sz value = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { AND = { planet = { NOT = { uses_district_set = habitat } } check_variable = { which = pe_code value > 62 } } planet = { uses_district_set = habitat exists = owner owner = { is_void_dweller_empire = yes } } } } set_variable = { which = pe_szd value = 0.33 } set_variable = { which = pe_wfall value = 300 } }
	else = { set_variable = { which = pe_szd value = 0.5 } set_variable = { which = pe_wfall value = 200 } if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 0 } } set_variable = { which = pe_szd value = 0.35 } } }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_wfall value = pe_sz }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_wf_miner value = pe_sz }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_wf_technician value = pe_sz }
	multiply_variable = { which = pe_wf_farmer value = pe_sz }
	}

# jobs are separate jobs and do not count). Deprioritised jobs do not count as free.

# Colony scope: buy a state district. Human empires on Free Market get an offer (one per
# quarter); AI empires and Laissez-faire buy directly.
pe_buy_or_offer = {
	if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_best_variant value = 1 } } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_planet_flag = pe_corp_hab }
				owner = { is_ai = no has_policy_flag = pe_order_free_market NOT = { has_country_flag = pe_offer_pending } check_variable = { which = pe_capital value >= 360 } }
			}
			set_timed_planet_flag = { flag = pe_cooldown days = 360 }
			set_timed_planet_flag = { flag = pe_buy_cd days = 720 }
			save_event_target_as = pe_offer_planet
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_offer_variant value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_offer_class value = 1 }
				set_variable = { which = pe_offer_hab value = 0 }
				if = { limit = { prev = { uses_district_set = habitat } } set_variable = { which = pe_offer_hab value = 1 } }
				set_timed_country_flag = { flag = pe_offer_pending days = 3600 }
				country_event = { id = pe.110 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { owner = { OR = { is_ai = yes has_policy_flag = pe_order_laissez_faire } } has_planet_flag = pe_corp_hab } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_ss_code value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_ss_scale value = 1 } } pe_safe_buy_1 = yes root = { set_variable = { which = pe_safe_ok value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = pe_safe_ready } } set_variable = { which = pe_safe_ok value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_sd_energy value < 0 } }
      set_variable = { which = pe_ss_test value = pe_safe_net_energy } change_variable = { which = pe_ss_test value = pe_safe_reserved_energy } change_variable = { which = pe_ss_test value = pe_sd_energy }
      if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_ss_test value < pe_safe_margin_energy } } set_variable = { which = pe_safe_ok value = 0 } }
    }

      set_variable = { which = pe_ss_test value = pe_safe_net_minerals } change_variable = { which = pe_ss_test value = pe_safe_reserved_minerals } change_variable = { which = pe_ss_test value = pe_sd_minerals }

    }

      set_variable = { which = pe_ss_test value = pe_safe_net_food } change_variable = { which = pe_ss_test value = pe_safe_reserved_food } change_variable = { which = pe_ss_test value = pe_sd_food }

      if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_ss_test value < pe_safe_margin_consumer_goods } } set_variable = { which = pe_safe_ok value = 0 } }
    }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_sd_trade value < 0 } }
      set_variable = { which = pe_ss_test value = pe_safe_net_trade } change_variable = { which = pe_ss_test value = pe_safe_reserved_trade } change_variable = { which = pe_ss_test value = pe_sd_trade }
      if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_ss_test value < pe_safe_margin_trade } } set_variable = { which = pe_safe_ok value = 0 } }
    } } if = { limit = { uses_district_set = habitat } pe_buyout_execute = { FIRM = d_pe_firm_aaac CODE = 1 DISTRICT = district_hab_housing RES = alloys MINERALS = 225 TRADE = 150 PRICE = 1050 } } else = { pe_buyout_execute = { FIRM = d_pe_firm_aaac CODE = 1 DISTRICT = district_city RES = minerals MINERALS = 750 TRADE = 150 PRICE = 900 } }
		}
	 }

# Colony scope, monthly: a finished construction site becomes its firm (unless it waits for
# workers, pe_hold, see pe_monthly_sites).
pe_site_complete = {
	root = { set_variable = { which = pe_site_done value = 0 } }
	random_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_sites check_variable = { which = pe_left value <= 0 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = pe_hold value = 1 } } }
		root = {
			set_variable = { which = pe_site_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = prev.pe_target }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = prev.pe_tstage }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_fcap value = prev.pe_fcap }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_debt value = prev.pe_debt }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_type value = prev.pe_kind }
			set_variable = { which = pe_old_code value = 0 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_old_stage value = 0 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_corp value = 0 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_loan value = 0 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_lender value = 0 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_loanq value = 0 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_fid value = 0 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_chg_supfid value = 0 }
		}
		if = { limit = { is_variable_set = pe_corp } root = { set_variable = { which = pe_chg_corp value = prev.pe_corp } } }
		if = {
			limit = { is_variable_set = pe_old_code }
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_old_code value = prev.pe_old_code }
				set_variable = { which = pe_old_stage value = prev.pe_old_stage }
			}
		}

	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_site_done value = 1 } } }
		save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet

# Country scope: the founding cost of variant root.pe_rb_code as a small firm (city
# 325, rural 200) -> pe_rb_cost.
pe_ruin_cost = {
	set_variable = { which = pe_rb_cost value = 325 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_rb_code value > 62 } } set_variable = { which = pe_rb_cost value = 200 } }
	}

# Colony scope: the state buys back the least valuable firm at the buyout price x size
# (if it can pay) and rebuilds the district. The investors get the price plus the firm's
# capital minus its remaining debt.
pe_nationalise_one = {
	root = {
		set_variable = { which = pe_worst value = 100000 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid_best value = 0 }
		set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 0 }
	}
	every_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms is_variable_set = pe_val }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_rid value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid value = root.pe_rid }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_val value < root.pe_worst } }
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_worst value = prev.pe_val }
				set_variable = { which = pe_rid_best value = prev.pe_rid }
			}
		}
	}
	random_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms is_variable_set = pe_val check_variable = { which = pe_rid value = root.pe_rid_best } }
		if = { limit = { planet = { NOT = { uses_district_set = habitat } } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 0 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = minerals amount >= 488 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 98 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { minerals = -488 trade = -98 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 586 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_debt } }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_nat_cls value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_nat_stage value = 0 } }
			pe_dep_remove = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { planet = { uses_district_set = habitat } check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_stage value = 0 } planet_owner = { has_resource = { type = alloys amount >= 146 } has_resource = { type = trade amount >= 98 } } }
			planet_owner = { add_resource = { alloys = -146 trade = -98 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = 682 } change_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_fcap } subtract_variable = { which = pe_capital value = prev.pe_debt } }

# Colony scope: the debt-free firm with the largest gain switches to the best variant
# available here (any class, same stage) if that is clearly better (+30% of its value, at
# least +3 trade per month), the firm is at least 10 years old (founded or last
# restructured), and nothing it makes becomes short by the switch (pe_retool_guard). It
# closes for half the build time (a construction site), and the planet pauses
# restructuring for 1 years. Cost: city 375 / rural 225 x size (pe_sz), paid
# from the firm's own capital only (never on credit). A rural target needs a free district of
# its type once the old firm is gone; if there is none, the old firm is restored, the
# cost paid back, and that rural type is not tried again on this planet for a year.

	every_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms is_variable_set = pe_val }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_rid value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_rid value = root.pe_rid }
		# A firm that suits the planet's designation only restructures into a variant that
		# suits it too.
		root = { set_variable = { which = pe_rl_prim value = prev.pe_prim } }
		if = {
			limit = { planet = { pe_desig_prim = yes } }
			set_variable = { which = pe_gain value = root.pe_cls_val_fit }
			set_variable = { which = pe_to_c value = root.pe_cls_var_fit }
		}

			set_variable = { which = pe_gain value = root.pe_cls_val_all }
			set_variable = { which = pe_to_c value = root.pe_cls_var_all }

		set_variable = { which = pe_thr value = pe_val }
		multiply_variable = { which = pe_thr value = 0.3 }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_thr value < 3 } } set_variable = { which = pe_thr value = 3 } }
		# A supply contract (as buyer or supplier) makes it less willing to change.
		if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { which = pe_sup_fid value > 0 } check_variable = { which = pe_sup_n value > 0 } } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_thr value = 1.5 } }
		# It consumes what the empire is short of: a third of that is enough (0.38). With a
		# supplier only two thirds (supply security, 0.46).
		if = {
			limit = { pe_firm_short = yes }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_sup_fid value > 0 } } multiply_variable = { which = pe_thr value = 0.66 } }
			else = { multiply_variable = { which = pe_thr value = 0.33 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { which = pe_debt value <= 0 }
				check_variable = { which = pe_loan value <= 0 }
				# Each firm's own pause (pe_age, quarters since founded or restructured): 10
				# years, 2 if it consumes what the empire is short of, 4 then
				# with a supplier: firms without one restructure first, but a lasting shortage
				# moves the others too.
				OR = {
					check_variable = { which = pe_age value >= 40 }
					AND = { pe_firm_short = yes NOT = { check_variable = { which = pe_sup_fid value > 0 } } check_variable = { which = pe_age value >= 8 } }
					AND = { pe_firm_short = yes check_variable = { which = pe_sup_fid value > 0 } check_variable = { which = pe_age value >= 16 } }
				}
				check_variable = { which = pe_gain value > pe_thr }
				check_variable = { which = pe_gain value > root.pe_best_gain }
			}
			pe_retool_guard = yes
			if = {
				limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_guard_ok value = 1 } } }
				root = {
					set_variable = { which = pe_best_gain value = prev.pe_gain }
					set_variable = { which = pe_rid_best value = prev.pe_rid }
					set_variable = { which = pe_to value = prev.pe_to_c }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	random_deposit = {
		limit = { has_deposit_category = pe_deposit_cat_firms is_variable_set = pe_val check_variable = { which = pe_rid value = root.pe_rid_best } }
		pe_retool_guard = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 1 } } set_variable = { which = pe_cost value = 375 } }
		else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_cls value = 5 } } set_variable = { which = pe_cost value = 375 } }
		else = { set_variable = { which = pe_cost value = 225 } }
		multiply_variable = { which = pe_cost value = pe_sz }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_fcap value >= pe_cost } root = { check_variable = { which = pe_guard_ok value = 1 } } }
			subtract_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = pe_cost }
			root = { set_variable = { which = pe_retool_ok value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_paid value = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_retool_ok value = 1 } } }
			root = {
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_code value = prev.pe_code }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_stage value = prev.pe_stage }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_fcap value = prev.pe_fcap }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_debt value = prev.pe_debt }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_cost value = prev.pe_cost }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_age value = prev.pe_age }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_corp value = prev.pe_corp }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_loan value = prev.pe_loan }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_lender value = prev.pe_lender }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_loanq value = prev.pe_loan_q }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_fid value = prev.pe_fid }
				set_variable = { which = pe_chg_supfid value = prev.pe_sup_fid }
			}
			pe_dep_remove = yes
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_retool_ok value = 1 } } }
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_to value = 1 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 1 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_debt value = root.pe_chg_debt } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = root.pe_chg_corp } set_variable = { which = pe_old_code value = root.pe_chg_code } set_variable = { which = pe_old_stage value = root.pe_chg_stage } } }
		else_if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_to value = 2 } } } add_deposit = d_pe_site_city last_added_deposit = { set_variable = { which = pe_target value = 2 } set_variable = { which = pe_tstage value = root.pe_chg_stage } set_variable = { which = pe_fcap value = root.pe_chg_fcap } set_variable = { which = pe_debt value = root.pe_chg_debt } set_variable = { which = pe_left value = 8 } set_variable = { which = pe_kind value = 3 } set_variable = { which = pe_corp value = root.pe_chg_corp } set_variable = { which = pe_old_code value = root.pe_chg_code } set_variable = { which = pe_old_stage value = root.pe_chg_stage } } }

# Colony scope: split root.pe_lv (trade per month, rounded down to 0.5) into the bit
# variables pe_$V$_b<i> of a ledger deposit.
pe_ledger_bits = {
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lv value >= 256 } } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b9 value = 1 }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_lv value = -256 } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b9 value = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lv value >= 128 } } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b8 value = 1 }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_lv value = -128 } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b8 value = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lv value >= 64 } } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b7 value = 1 }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_lv value = -64 } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b7 value = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lv value >= 32 } } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b6 value = 1 }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_lv value = -32 } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b6 value = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lv value >= 16 } } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b5 value = 1 }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_lv value = -16 } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b5 value = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lv value >= 8 } } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b4 value = 1 }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_lv value = -8 } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b4 value = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lv value >= 4 } } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b3 value = 1 }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_lv value = -4 } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b3 value = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lv value >= 2 } } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b2 value = 1 }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_lv value = -2 } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b2 value = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lv value >= 1 } } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b1 value = 1 }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_lv value = -1 } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b1 value = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_lv value >= 0.5 } } }
		set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b0 value = 1 }
		root = { change_variable = { which = pe_lv value = -0.5 } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { which = pe_$V$_b0 value = 0 } }
	}

# Colony scope (the source planet): move the marked firm (pe_rl_cand) to
# event_target:pe_rl_dst with its workers. The firm closes here, its workers become
# civilians, and as many civilians move along (in groups of 10, only groups for whom the
# destination is at least as habitable); the firm reopens there at once with its stage,
# capital and debt. Like vanilla resettle_pop_group, inlined (call depth).

			}

							}
						}
					}

				}

			set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_tri_r }
			change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_g_r }
			multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = 100 }
			set_variable = { which = pe_tmp2 value = pe_g_sum }
			multiply_variable = { which = pe_tmp2 value = pe_tgt_r }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_tmp value < pe_tmp2 } } set_variable = { which = pe_guard_ok value = 0 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_g_u value < 0 } }
			set_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_tri_u }
			change_variable = { which = pe_tmp value = pe_g_u }

			if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = pe_tmp value < pe_tmp2 } } set_variable = { which = pe_guard_ok value = 0 } }

# Colony scope (after pe_merge_apply, root = owner): the merger message naming the surviving
# firm (FIRM, root.pe_mg_code at stage pe_mg_stg), the absorbed one (in the localisation key,
# root.pe_mg_ocode) and what the survivor becomes (NEW: its variant a stage larger).
pe_merge_message = {
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { is_ai = no } }
		save_event_target_as = pe_msg_planet
		if = { limit = { root = { check_variable = { which = pe_mg_ocode value = 1 } check_variable = { which = pe_mg_stg value = 0 } } } pe_merge_message_a_0 = { OTHER = d_pe_firm_aaac_0 } }
